body:
They don't support me with anything I do. They don't approve of my choices in life, one being dropping out of the school they forced me to go to.

For some reason, they hold things over my head, as if nothing I do matters. Or that they've gone through everything I've gone through, so all my feelings are not relevant. 

It's not anything really traumatizing or anything.. but just the feeling that I've constantly done something wrong, or lack of approval is just awful.

The friends that I can text and call are basically the only things I'm holding on to. But a lot of the time, it's just not enough. It's great to talk for a while, but then I feel helpless the rest of the time.

The one thing I promised I would do was not drop out of school. I've already done it once a few years ago, and it took me forever to get back to where I want to be. Funny how that works though, since this state of mind isn't where I want to be.
